code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,5))
# stairs
for i in range(3):
    x0=i*0.254
    y0=-i*0.197
    ax.plot([x0, x0+0.254, x0+0.254],[y0, y0, y0-0.197],'k-', lw=2)
ax.text(0.1, 0.05, 'riser 197mm', fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.3, -0.18, 'going 254mm', fontsize=8)
# tri-star carrier
import math
cx, cy = 0.254, -0.10
ax.plot([cx],[cy],'ko')
for a in [90,210,330]:
    r=0.14
    wx=cx+r*math.cos(math.radians(a))
    wy=cy+r*math.sin(math.radians(a))
    ax.plot([cx, wx],[cy, wy],'k-')
    c=plt.Circle((wx,wy),0.075, fill=False, lw=2)
    ax.add_patch(c)
ax.text(cx+0.02, cy+0.02, 'tri-star carrier\norbit 140mm', fontsize=8)
# frame spine
ax.plot([cx, cx-0.25],[cy, cy+0.9],'k-', lw=3)
ax.text(cx-0.35, cy+0.7, 'spine 1200mm', fontsize=8)
# toe plate + load
ax.plot([cx+0.05, cx+0.45],[cy-0.15, cy-0.15],'k-', lw=3)
ax.text(cx+0.15, cy-0.22, 'toe 450x350mm', fontsize=8)
bx, by = cx+0.05, cy-0.15
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((bx,by),0.35,0.45, fill=False, lw=2))
ax.text(bx+0.05, by+0.2, '60kg parcel', fontsize=8)
ax.text(cx-0.3, cy+0.95, 'handles 90-110cm', fontsize=8)
ax.text(cx-0.4, cy-0.1, 'brake band\non carrier', fontsize=8)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
